title: Trend Micro Deep Security Manager Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Trend Micro Deep Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Deep Security Manager console. The issue results from the lack of proper validation prior to authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
